notes.title: Patch 1.13.5
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers! Our first patch is here:

- Fixed a soft lock in Chapter 6 (you could stay trapped on the small island)
- Various Translations fixes/improvements

We'd appreciate if you could leave a review for the game so that it will help get the ball rolling, thank you so much! Counting on you folks!

Cheers
